message: なにげにヒント
Alongside preparations for the Kirafes, finding spare moments amidst the busyness--.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh my, blown to smithereens」

name: Ria
message: 「You've got some serious power there, Nanaka」

name: Synn
message: 「With this much firepower, nothing stands a chance」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hmm~~. Still, the timing for aiming is a bit tricky, isn't it」

name: Misa
message: 「No matter how strong an attack is, it's meaningless if it doesn't hit」

name: Ria
message: 「You're great at stopping the opponent's movements, Misa」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, though she kind of lacks a decisive finishing blow」

name: Misa
message: 「Says the one who only knows how to fight like a brute, Nanaka」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What was that!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, that's why the key in times like that is to fight by playing to each other's strengths」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean by that?」

name: Ria
message: 「For example, first Misa slows the opponent down with an attack, and then Nanaka follows up with a 'Zugoooogooooon!!'」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Ria
message: 「'BAGOOOOOON!!'」

name: Synn
message: 「Um, Ria-senpai...」

name: Ria
message: 「Lolotte, get ready to heal him, okay」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oka~y, all set and ready to go~\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't tell me that means...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm playing nurse today~~♪」

name: Ria
message: 「This might hurt a little. Ehehe\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't give me 'ehehe'--」

name: Misa
message: 「Prepare yourself!」

name: Synn
message: 「Waaaaah!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Hey!! If you run away, this won't be any practice at all!!」

name: Ria
message: 「That's right, Synn. You could have turned the tables if you'd just fought back.」

name: Synn
message: 「That was a sneak attack, wasn't it!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And now, it's my turn!」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm just the warmup act!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Eek!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Gahaaa!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Pain, pain, fly away like a moth to the summer flame.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-thank you...」

name: Ria
message: 「See? Everyone's skills are really starting to show their individuality, aren't they?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm just the punching bag, and you haven't even done anything, Senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha...\s01」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm basically the one who saps the opponent's will to fight, and as for you, Synn...」

name: Synn
message: 「What about me?」

name: Ria
message: 「W-well... I guess your individuality is that nobody really knows what it is?」

name: Synn
message: 「How half-assed.」

name: Ria
message: 「It's not half-assed! That's the conclusion I reached after watching you closely as your senpai!」

name: Synn
message: 「Making things up again.」

name: Ria
message: 「I said I'm not making it up~!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Anyway, it just means you're still an unknown quantity! You need to train way, waaaay harder than you do now, Synn!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah. It's totally ridiculous that you're the weakest one here.」

name: Misa
message: 「Though even if you work hard, you'll probably only barely catch up to me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「As the saying goes, a bad workman rests on his laurels, after all.」

name: Synn
message: 「Grrrr... Is it really okay for the Student Council President to be treated like this?!」

name: Ria
message: 「How things turn out is all up to you, Synn」

name: Synn
message: 「A-alright! Senpai... please go out with me!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Huh?」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh my!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How bold~~」

name: Ria
message: 「G-going out with you, you say... ba-dump」

name: Synn
message: 「Senpai?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Now, now. You shouldn't be teasing the president like that, Ria」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, Misasagi-senpai. Hello there. What do you mean by me getting teased?」

name: Ria
message: 「You meant keeping you company for practice, right. Ahaha... everyone else played along so I just couldn't help myself\s02」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaah, so that's what this was about!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah! That's right!」

name: Misa
message: 「Right!! Of course that's what it was!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「So it wasn't a courtship command after all」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You really are an honest girl, aren't you, Lolotte~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There you are, Bubuzuke!! Today's the day I make you say 'Gah!!' with my ultimate finishing move!!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「'Gah!!'--will that do nicely?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Grrr... I'll let you off with just this for today!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Much obliged. Ria, here are some refreshments for you」

name: Ria
message: 「Waa~~ thank you~~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Refreshments from the Wagashi Club means it's gotta be...」

name: Ria
message: 「Wagashiii~~\s04」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Would you have preferred Western sweets instead?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Leave soba to the soba shop, you know!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If you're going to say that, it's mochi」

name: Misa
message: 「To think I'd be corrected by Lolotte-san...」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry to trouble you--wait, wagashi?」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, we're the Wagashi Club, after all」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That's right, yeah」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, that makes sense」
I wonder if the reason Ria-senpai always had wagashi on her was thanks to her club?
Though it seems she quit to draw a proper line when she became Student Council President.

name: Lolotte
message: 「Well then, thank you for the food~」

name: Misa
message: 「Thank you very much. Let's dig in」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Aren't you gonna eat?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even if my pride allows it, cake will never forgive me!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Aren't they sweets too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Then I'll gladly have some in your place. Aaahhh~」

name: Ria
message: 「Hold it right there~\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaah--」

name: Ria
message: 「Come on, let's close that big mouth\s04 That's sloppy\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be...」

name: Ria
message: 「You're still going to keep practicing, aren't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「So I have to wait, huh」

name: Ria
message: 「Moving around right after eating is bad for your body. If you eat after you exercise, you'll absorb the nutrients properly」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. So that secret is what built Senpai-san's amazing figure」

name: Nanaka
message: 「And chewing your food well. Munch, munch」

name: Synn
message: 「You're sneaking bites already」

name: Ria
message: 「I'm holding back from eating too, you know」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that so...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You're always eating, Ria. You can put up with this much」

name: Ria
message: 「Waaah!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Haha. So even you can't eat until practice is over, Ria-senpai. Got it」

name: Ria
message: 「Jeez, Akane-chan~~」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Heehee, forgive me」

name: Ria
message: 「Well then, shall we go a round?\s07」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes!」

name: Misasagi
message: 「How gallant」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Of course, he is our counselor, after all」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not really something for you to puff your chest out over, Nanaka-san」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oh my, oh my. Aren't there still some daifuku left over?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ah, those are--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'll help myself, then! Nom! Nom!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They're delicious~~\s07」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Sorry to both of you~~\s02」
